notes.title: Priest Simulator: Vampire Show is FINALLY available in FULL VERSION!
notes.notes:
We've thanked you a few times already, but there's no such thing as too many thank-yous. So here it is again: thank you for being part of, let’s not kid ourselves, the most important adventure of our professional lives. It’s still a bit too early for a proper postmortem where we could dive into all the highs and lows, but that moment will definitely come. We've been working on this project for... I don’t even know how long anymore, probably around six years, and honestly, it might be Priest that influenced us more than we influenced Priest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/950620/Priest_Simulator_Vampire_Show/

It’s been amazing that so many of you played and reviewed the game, streamed it, created art, did cosplays, listened to Gruzja, had fun with us on social media, and that I got to meet so many of you in person—especially at concerts. Asmodev is still here because of you ready to work on new projects. Life is sad and meaningless, and yet you still managed to smile. Bravo to you, you freaks.

Her Ghost DLC
Free is the best price but unfortunately we have to live (promise, it won't last long), so it's just cheap. Her Ghost is an add-on containing a quest that continues the events of Vampire Show. Kinda funny, seriously cringe, one of a kind. That is, it's one of a kind in the same way as Heavy Duty and Vampire Show, which makes it one-third of a kind.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/

Priest Simulator: Vampire Show | Full Release Changelog
Added/New
 Added the raid quest
 Added the meeting in the church basement
 Added particles for car kills
 Added missing VO
 Added sound effects to the basement
 Added a sound effect for collecting offerings
 Added particles to the baseball bat
 Added new character models
 Added collision to Wickerman’s backpack
 Added your photos in balaclavas
 Added lip-sync for Satanists
 Added Kremuva retrospectives and the associated quest
 Added a few cutscenes to clarify the story
 Added translations for tutorials
 Added the ability to mark all exorcisms on the map
 New: Her Ghost DLC
Improvements
 Improved door textures
 Improved enemy weapon particles
 Improved the wheel menu cheat sheet
 Optimized game saving
Changes
 Modified the cutscene of Diabolina converting the Christianists
 Modified LODs
 Adjusted NPC spawn points to be consistent with cutscenes
 Changed triggers that activate cutscenes
Fixes
 Fixed the acetylene cutscene
 Fixed NPCs holding items
 Fixed menu links
 Fixed overlapping audio tracks
 Fixed collisions in the church
 Fixed object disappearance bugs
 Fixed an issue where Torpedo woke up too early, making the funeral quest nonsensical
 Fixed the exorcism win/lose system, which could break the game
 Fixed animation glitches in many cutscenes
 Fixed glitches on Orlok's mask
 Fixed a bug where Melissa would leave the table and start wandering
 Fixed task tracking after completing an exorcism
 Resolved a potential game lock in the "French Connection" quest
 Resolved the disappearing Vamela bug after the first exorcism quest
 Resolved an issue with the missing task to change the time
Other
 Disabled radio at the start of the game
 Blocked the ability to spin the slot machine again after winning a prize
 Enabled access to the haunted house next to the casino
 Extended the exorcism ending screen display
Removed
 Removed a lock that sometimes remained after the cannon cutscene
 Removed an invisible collision near the bakery
 Removed the ability to reset attack animations

In addition to the changes listed above, we decided not to include (in the list, not patch) over 1,000 fixes and tweaks because, honestly, nobody would read through them all. We're talking about thrilling stuff like fixing typos, tweaking voice-over sounds, and zapping micro-bugs that would make even the most devout patch note reader lose faith. Yes, we could have listed every corrected “i before e” and every adjustment to the subtle hum of NPC whispers but we figured you’d rather enjoy the game than scroll through a list longer than the Book of Psalms. You're welcome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/d903391deab7559efad8b5d48f8f06cc44d5570a.jpg

If something doesn't sit well with you, feel free to file a complaint—preferably right under this post. We're leaving Early Access, but we're always (un)happy to fix what needs fixing.

notes.title: Patch of the day
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41314581/2bb5ef5dbc6a73aab82d2ae79e5fa91a579da83e.jpg

We did it again. A patch that will blow your heads out of your boots. A lot of improvements, a lot of bugs, a lot of everything in its right place. In its right place. A lemon. Finally, it works. Now it's your turn, guys. You got this game for free, show us your best. Release the beast inside you.

notes.title: The Last of Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41314581/de69d3fe81ed44370e3df0920d40fdb6ed5d37d4.png

No time to joke. We're patching Priest Simulator, so Heavy Duty is inevitably backfired. This time we managed to:

correct the differences between subtitles and dubbing in the pl version,
correct the differences between subtitles and dubbing in the eng version,
improve existing cutscenes,
remove overlapping sounds in the final cutscene,
fix a critical bug with the "depends on the cup" issue,
correct names,
add 3 cutscenes,
explain what to clean the basement means,
explain why Orlok responds to Mortimer's greetings,
add some music,
enrich the sound of cutscenes,
add cesspool sounds,
add the ability to get up using a jump,
improve social media buttons,
add a tip on how to change a quick item,
add a sound when we access a new weapon,
improve the content of tasks,
correct some dialogues.

XXX ː2018salienbeast1ː.

notes.notes:
Yello. The patch is about:
